verdict.rationale: Gmail's own Gemini 'Organize' capability lets users ask the AI to act on many messages at once, such as deleting multiple emails or adding labels. That is a direct, AI-native bulk operation, but it rests on a single thin docs mention. Filters only apply recurring rules to messages as they arrive, which is not a one-off bulk action on existing items. The API docs mention managing messages and labels but do not document batch operations. Missing for 10: documented scope and limits of Gemini bulk actions (how many items, which operation types), any documented bulk or batch API endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Organize: Ask Gemini to do things like delete multiple emails or add labels.
The Gmail API lets you view and manage Gmail mailbox data like threads, messages, and labels.
